# `aitbc agent register-identity`

Register an agent's identity and address on the blockchain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent register-identity [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | The Agent id. |
| `--agent-address` | text | — | yes | The Agent address. |
| `--display-name` | text | — | no | Agent display name |
| `--agent-type` | text | `general` | no | Agent type (general, provider, consumer) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent register-identity --agent-id <agent_id> --agent-address <agent_address>
```
